summary: Late planning-result reconciliation is not exact while the task is awaiting plan approval.
findings: isExternalPlanningResultApplied returns true for every plan_approval route before comparing the persisted plan with the returned PLANNER summary; a stale result can therefore complete against a different plan.
missing_tests: Reject an effect-in-doubt PLANNER result when a different plan is currently awaiting approval, without consuming the exchange or completing the journal operation.
hidden_assumptions: The plan_approval route was treated as proof that the exact returned plan had already been applied.
